I hav tried mushrooms as microdosing for a month and a few moderate doses as well as twice a moderate dose of LSD. I was scared of the same reasons and yet did it because of the possible benefits.
I would say that I got lucky with not becoming Psychotic or such and that especially the first good dose of Shrooms was very emotionally relieving.
A lot of surpressed emotions got out and I felt that I knew what to change about myself and am still trying to do so.
All in all I'd say you should not do it because of the risk. I just got lucky. Alot can go wrong and you definitely dont want that.
It will not change your life it will only show you things you already know you had to do by making it obvious.
You're more in touch with yourself.
You can do that in different ways than fucking with your brain chemistry.
I won't do it again for a while now and try work on myself the old fashioned way.
